department: Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources

deadline.value: General international Fall 2027 deadline listed by Graduate Studies is May 1, 2027; the IAFES catalog lists May 30 for international applicants and June 30 for domestic applicants (Spring: Oct 15 intl / Nov 15 domestic).
deadline.quote: Enrollment Term U.S. Applicants International Applicants Fall (August) June 30 May 1

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Agricultural or Environmental Sciences (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: All applicants are required to identify and communicate with a potential faculty advisor prior to applying (also used for potential research assistantship opportunities).
supervisor.quote: REQUIRED OF ALL APPLICANTS: ... Identify and be in communication with a potential Advisor prior to application to the program for potential research assistantship opportunities.

funding.value: Research assistantships, fellowships via departmental grant funding, and tuition fee waivers are available on a competitive basis through potential faculty advisors and the university.
funding.quote: Identify and be in communication with a potential Advisor prior to application to the program for potential research assistantship opportunities.

also.quote: Financial Aid at the University is made available for graduate students through tuition fee waivers, research fellowships via departmental grant funding, departmental assistantships, loans and part-time employment opportunities.

entry_route.value: Both M.S. holders (45-credit track, 3.0 minimum GPA) and outstanding B.S. holders (60-credit track, 3.25 minimum GPA) in STEM disciplines are eligible to apply.
entry_route.quote: Potential applicants holding an M.S. Degree in STEM disciplines are eligible to apply for the IAEFS Ph.D. Program. Applicants with a B.S. degree with outstanding backgrounds are also eligible to apply.

notes: Interdisciplinary CAST program spanning agriculture, food science, biotechnology, and environmental sciences; requires CV, three recommendation letters, primary advisor plus co-advisor, and external internship/shadowing.
name: Ph.D. in Integrative Agricultural, Food and Environmental Sciences
